verdict.rationale: Lighthouse publishes public blog guides with some substance, including an EB-1A approval-rate piece with frank premium-processing and RFE/NOID strategy, an E-2 treaty-countries post, a sponsorship-cost comparison and an H-4 guide. A customer-stories page filterable by founders supplies real examples. However, the visa pages are mostly service-marketing copy ('we work with you to map your accomplishments'), and the criteria checks are interactive quizzes that read like lead capture rather than written breakdowns. Missing for 10: explicit founder/startup-visa-specific guides (e.g., entrepreneur pathways), detailed written criteria-by-criteria breakdowns, step-by-step process explainers, confirmation that content is fully ungated, independent corroboration of guide depth.
